## Description
Two independently executed source-bound Full runs after Terminal fix #3315 fail deterministically at `e2e/tests/browser/fixture-app.spec.ts:47` ("an emerged capability does not reflow the terminal (#826)"): [Staging Full #43201620104](https://github.com/BestNathan/nession/actions/runs/43201620104) at `12d67a16ff09de495bda3fd69b969aaf5a40047c` (478 passed, 1 failed), and [Main Full #43204538865](https://github.com/BestNathan/nession/actions/runs/43204538865) at `c3a7c24f8a74e066ede36531e939fd0b92b696ad` (477 passed, 1 failed). The failing locator waits for `capsule-capability-picker-git` or `capsule-context-item-git`; both retries fail.

This is a **separate fixture/test migration bug** blocking fresh Full evidence for #3200, not a recurrence of its WebSocket issue, nor grounds to reopen #826.

## Reproduction
1. Run the existing canonical `fixture-app` browser spec in authenticated CI (App viewport 390×844).
2. The test opens `/#/fixture/app` and requests `openCapsuleCapability(page, 'git')`.
3. The capability row is absent and Playwright times out before it can assert Terminal geometry. Re-running the same SHA reproduces the result.

## Root Cause
[PR #3317](https://github.com/BestNathan/nession/pull/3317) implementing #1290 intentionally removed the old Git Terminal Peek: `gitProjection` is no longer in `web/src/app/capsuleProjections.ts`. `resolveCapsuleCapabilities` filters all Capsule entries to registered `CAPSULE_PROJECTION_IDS`. Git now opens its full Workspace view and must not be injected back into Terminal solely to make a stale fixture pass. `fixture-app.spec.ts` retained the retired picker assumption.

## Impact
Blocks otherwise relevant canonical Full regression attestation and hence prevents newly qualified Staging-source SC-02 proof for #3200, despite that Issue's repaired `terminal-io` scenario passing.

## Fix Direction
- Keep #1290's approved Git Workspace-only behavior; **do not restore** legacy Git Peek or weaken the capability presence filter.
- In `fixture-app.spec.ts`, use the currently registered, Session-scoped `terminal-keys` App projection (with real DOM body) for the #826 geometry invariant.
- Preserve before/emerged/dismiss measurements of Terminal Well, xterm geometry and `--terminal-capsule-occlusion`; do not skip a spec, lower thresholds, or accept retries as zero-flaky.
- Verify existing `fixture-app` browser regression on exact PR head and then let the trusted Full/acceptance pipeline independently evaluate the next source-bound integration for #3200.

### Success Criteria
- [x] SC-01 The #826 browser fixture uses an actually registered App Terminal capability rather than removed Git Peek, without changing the canonical geometry/no-reflow/dismiss assertions or restoring retired Git Terminal UI.

**SC → scenario:** SC-01=SCN-01 exact-source test contract/registration boundary; the independently executed `fixture-app` Chromium regression (SCN-02) is separately mandatory as the existing E2E declaration, not a model claim.

## Acceptance Plan
```yaml
acceptance:
  SC-01:
    when: pr
    method: agent
```

## Acceptance Report
| Criterion | Result | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| SC-01 | Pass | run 43209878850; ref f880a5c46878b8c5fcce94b717a9b99513744ac6; source agent-qwen; file: e2e/tests/browser/fixture-app.spec.ts:101 uses openCapsuleCapability(page, 'terminal-keys') instead of removed Git Peek; file: web/src/app/capsuleProjections.ts:163-168 CAPSULE_PROJECTIONS registers terminalKeysProjection but not gitProjection; file: e2e/tests/browser/fixture-app.spec.ts:97-129 preserves canonical geometry/no-reflow/dismiss assertions with before/emerged/dismiss measurements; file: web/src/product/terminal/terminalToolIds.ts:8 TERMINAL_KEYS_ID = 'terminal-keys' matches the registered projection; summary: The #826 fixture now uses terminal-keys (a registered App Terminal capability with real DOM body) instead of removed Git Peek, while preserving all canonical geometry, no-reflow, and dismissal assertions without restoring retired Git Terminal UI. |

## E2E Verification
### New
- none: repair the existing browser fixture without adding an overlapping spec
### Regression
- fixture-app

| fixture-app | Regression | Pass | run 43209053662/2, SHA f880a5c46878b8c5fcce94b717a9b99513744ac6, contract 605d20017d0bdb52288c4302fe02232b9ee1d3a00538c0080d8513a0b5412a91, plan 406e0ce1470cc27abcc1e2170d3ffd252ce41ab10cb9d8499c3a5a37d521a620, tests 13/13 (https://github.com/BestNathan/nession/actions/runs/43209053662) |

## Prototype
- Decision: Not needed
- Reason: No product/UI behavior changes; existing approved Git Workspace-only design retained.

## Product alignment
- [x] Current Session-owned Terminal capability discovery, not fabricated Git Peek.
- [x] Exact browser geometry and strict Full attestation remain unchanged.

## Location
- `e2e/tests/browser/fixture-app.spec.ts`
- `e2e/helpers/capsule.ts` (read-only reference; no change expected)
- `web/src/app/capsuleProjections.ts` (existing approved implementation; do not change)
